children: Overview
China medical device maker's H1 revenue rose 56.9% yr/yr to RMB291 mln
Net profit attributable to shareholders grew 18.5% yr/yr to RMB60.4 mln
Company cites product recognition and demand as key drivers for growth
Outlook
Company expects CE certification for Embolic Coil System in Q3 2026
Clinical enrolment for Carotid Artery Stent expected to complete within 2026
Result Drivers
PRODUCT ADOPTION - Co said expanded hospital adoption and upgrades to ischemic stroke products, including Aspiration Catheter, drove steady growth in sales
HEMORRHAGIC STROKE SEGMENT - Co said hemorrhagic stroke business was fastest-growing, with Vascular Reconstruction Device and Embolic Coil System sales volumes rising sharply
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY - Co said digitalization, AI deployment and lean production initiatives improved efficiency and lifted gross margin
